blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Savouge stunned defending champion Criss Cross, 25-15, 25-21, 25-17, to stay unbeaten in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference semifinals on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan. Joeven Dela Vega regained his scoring touch just in time to push their finals bid with 18 points on a 17-of-26 spiking clip and a block for a 2-0 record tied with National University-Archipelago, which will be their next game on Friday. Dela Vega bounced back from his seven-point outing in their five-set escape against Far Eastern University-DN Steel on Monday, responding to coach and owner Sydney Calderon’s challenge. READ: […]...
